aboutPage.metaDescription: Menupedia gives restaurants a digital menu guests open with one scan, and that the restaurant keeps up to date itself.

hero.title: Digital menus that restaurants run themselves
hero.intro: Guests scan a QR code at the table and see your menu on their phone, in their language. You change prices, dishes and photos yourself, and it's live in seconds.

story.title: Why Menupedia
story.p1: Printed menus go out of date the moment a price changes or a dish runs out. Many digital menus are just a PDF: hard to read on a phone, the same for every guest, and still a job for someone else to update.
story.p2: Menupedia is built the other way round: a real menu page made for phones, which the restaurant's own team keeps up to date from any device, in as many languages as its guests speak.

s1.title: Get your account
s1.text: We set up your restaurant and send you a link. Invite your staff with their own links: owners manage everything, editors look after the menu.

s2.title: Build your menu
s2.text: Add categories and dishes with prices, photos and dietary labels. A step-by-step checklist and a private preview help you get everything ready before guests see it.

s3.title: Make it yours
s3.text: Choose a design and your colours, add your opening hours, and translate the menu for guests who speak other languages.

s4.title: Put it on the tables
s4.text: Print table cards with your QR code. Guests scan and see an up-to-date menu, and you see how many opened it each day.

audiences.title: Made for both sides of the table

guests.title: For guests
guests.text: A menu that opens instantly on their phone, in their language, with photos, prices in a familiar format, dietary filters and the restaurant's hours and location.

restaurants.title: For restaurants
restaurants.text: No reprinting and no waiting for anyone: change the menu yourself, see what guests do, and look your best on Google and when your menu is shared.

phones.title: Phones first
phones.text: Most guests open a menu on a phone at the table, so every page is designed and tested for small screens first.

everyone.title: Every guest
everyone.text: Five languages, right-to-left included, readable colours and screen-reader support, so no guest is left guessing.

current.title: Always current
current.text: What guests see is what you have today: sold-out dishes are marked, and changes appear straight away.

yours.title: Your restaurant
yours.text: Your name, your design and your colours. The menu should feel like part of your restaurant, not ours.

cta.title: See it for yourself
cta.text: Try our demo restaurant, or browse the menus already on Menupedia.

hero.title: Simple pricing for your digital menu
hero.intro: Start free: the first {months} cost nothing, and you don't need a card to sign up. After that, one plan with everything for {price} a month.

included.title: Everything is in the plan
included.intro: No add-ons, and no charges per scan, table or dish.

s1.title: Sign up and build your menu
s1.text: Create your restaurant, add your dishes and check everything in a private preview. No card details needed.

s2.title: Use it for {months}
s2.text: Put your menu live, print your table cards and update the menu as often as you like, all for free.

s3.title: Decide when the trial ends
s3.text: We'll get in touch before your free months end. Pay by card or in cash, monthly or yearly. If you don't continue, your menu simply goes offline.

free.a: Yes. Nothing is charged for the first {months}, and you don't enter card details to sign up. You only tell us how you'd like to pay later.

after.q: What happens when the free months end?
after.a: We'll call or message you before then. Once your first payment is in, your menu stays live. If you don't pay, your menu goes offline, and it comes back as soon as you do.

pay.a: By card or in cash. For card payments we send you a secure payment page before the trial ends; for cash we get in touch to arrange it.

yearly.q: Is it cheaper to pay yearly?
yearly.a: Yes. A year costs {yearly}, which is {saving} compared with paying monthly.

extras.q: Are there extra fees for scans, tables or dishes?
extras.a: No. Your price stays the same however many guests scan your menu, and however many tables and dishes you have.

guests.q: Do guests pay anything or need an app?
guests.a: No. Guests scan the QR code with their phone camera and the menu opens in the browser. It's free for them, with nothing to install.

chains.q: I run several restaurants or a chain. What does it cost?
chains.a: Get in touch and tell us about your places, and we'll find the right plan with you.

cta.title: Start your free trial
cta.text: Set up your menu today and pay nothing for {months}.

multilingualPage.metaTitle: Multilingual QR menu in 5 languages | Menupedia
multilingualPage.metaDescription: Show guests your menu in English, Turkish, Arabic, Spanish or Russian. One QR code opens it in the language of their phone, with Arabic right to left.

hero.title: One QR code, and every guest reads your menu in their language
hero.intro: Tourists, expats and visitors from abroad scan the same code and see your dishes in English, Turkish, Arabic, Spanish or Russian. No more translating at the table.

s1.title: Pick your languages
s1.text: Choose your menu's main language, then add any of the others: English, Turkish, Arabic, Spanish and Russian.

s2.title: Add the translations
s2.text: Each dish has a tab per language for its name, description and ingredients, and categories get their own names too. The editor marks what isn't translated yet.

s3.title: Guests scan
s3.text: The menu opens in the language of the guest's phone when your menu has it, otherwise in your main language. Guests can switch language at any time.

demo.title: Try it in the demo menu
demo.intro: Switch the language of our demo restaurant's menu and watch every dish change, Arabic right to left included.

rtl.title: Arabic, right to left
rtl.text: Arabic menus read from right to left, as Arabic-speaking guests expect.

prices.title: Prices they can read
prices.text: Prices appear in the format guests are used to, in your currency.

search.title: Search in any language
search.text: Guests can search for dishes in their own language or by the names on your main menu.

labels.title: Dietary labels, translated
labels.text: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and the other labels appear in each guest's language automatically.

hours.title: Opening hours in their language
hours.text: "Open now" and your opening hours appear in the guest's language, worked out in your time zone.

google.title: Found in every language
google.text: Each language of your menu is its own page for search engines, so guests can find it searching in their own language.

who.title: Who it's for
who.text: Restaurants, cafés and bars in tourist areas, hotels and their restaurants, and places near airports, universities and international neighbourhoods: anywhere guests don't all speak the same language.

auto.a: No. You add the translations yourself, or with help from a colleague or a translator, so every dish says exactly what you mean. Anything not translated yet is shown in your main language, and the editor marks what's missing.

languages.q: Which languages can my menu be in?
languages.a: English, Turkish, Arabic, Spanish and Russian. Your main language can be any of them.

qr.q: Do I need a separate QR code for each language?
qr.a: No. One QR code works for every language: each guest sees the menu in their own.

switch.a: Yes. The menu has a language switcher, so guests can change language whenever they like.

price.a: No. Menus in several languages are included in the plan.

cta.title: Give every guest your menu in their language
cta.text: Start your free trial: menus in several languages are included in the plan.

faqPage.metaDescription: Answers about Menupedia's QR menus: getting started, updating your menu, languages, QR codes, branches, pricing and what guests see.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.intro: What restaurants usually ask before they start. Can't find your question? Get in touch.

what.a: Menupedia is a digital menu for restaurants, cafés, bakeries and other places. Guests scan a QR code and your menu opens on their phone, in their language. You manage it yourself from your dashboard.

app.q: Do guests need to download an app?
app.a: No. Guests scan the QR code with their phone camera and the menu opens in the browser.

how.a: Sign up, enter your restaurant's details and add your dishes. A checklist and a private preview help you get everything ready. Once we've confirmed your sign-up, put your menu live and print your table cards.

skills.a: No. If you can fill in a form on your phone or computer, you can build your menu.

update.q: Can I change prices and dishes myself?
update.a: Yes, at any time. Change a price, add a dish or mark it sold out, and guests see it straight away. There's nothing to reprint.

qr.q: Will my QR codes still work if I change my menu?
qr.a: Yes. Your QR code points to a permanent link that always opens your current menu, even if your menu's address changes.

photos.q: Can I add photos of my dishes?
photos.a: Yes. Each dish can have a photo, and guests can tap a dish to see it larger with its details.

team.q: Can my staff update the menu?
team.a: Yes. Invite them with a link: editors look after the menu, and owners also manage the restaurant's details.

branches.q: I have several branches. Can each have its own page?
branches.a: Yes. Each branch gets its own page with its address, phone, map and opening hours, and they share the same menu.

design.q: Can the menu match my brand?
design.a: Yes. Choose one of three designs, add your logo and pick your own colours for light and dark mode.

languages.q: Can guests read the menu in their language?
languages.a: Yes. Your menu can be in English, Turkish, Arabic, Spanish and Russian, and it opens in the language of each guest's phone.

hours.q: Do guests see whether we're open?
hours.a: Yes. Add your opening hours and the menu shows "Open now" or when you open next.

google.q: Will my menu show up on Google?
google.a: Your menu pages are built so search engines understand your dishes, prices and opening hours, in every language your menu has. That helps guests find you when they search for your restaurant.

stats.q: Can I see how many people look at my menu?
stats.a: Yes. Your dashboard shows how many guests opened your menu each day.

data.q: Do guests have to sign up or share any details?
data.a: No. Guests read your menu without signing up or entering anything.

cost.a: The first {months} are free. After that it's {price} a month, or {yearly} a year, with everything included.

pay.a: By card or in cash, monthly or yearly. Nothing is charged during the free trial.

more.title: Still have a question?
more.text: Email us or message us on WhatsApp. We're happy to help.
